messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager P1 - MULTI-GPU COLLECTIVE HANG detected in cluster inference-prod-3 at 03:14 UTC. Symptoms: repeated NCCL timeout, GPU Xid errors, tasks stuck in rendezvous. Bridge: https://meet.internal/incident/3789994321
jamie_oncall: I'm oncall, joining bridge now. anyone observing customer-facing errors?
morgan_serving: saw spike in 500s from /generate at 03:13. Traces show token generation stalled when switching to tp4 sharding. NCCL reported TIMEOUT repeatedly.
priya_support: several customers (ids: cust_8421, cust_9102) reported increased latency and a few failed requests. Not widespread yet but trend rising.
jamie_oncall: ok tagging infra and ml. @rachel_infra @tony_ml can you triage hardware vs runtime?
rachel_infra: looking at node set gpu-pool-b. A few nodes showing gpu driver resets (Xid 79) and container restarts. Kernel OOPS on one ephemeral node.
ton y_ml: model runner logs show hangs at allreduce step for pipeline parallel groups. NCCL communicator errors: "ncclComm: timeout waiting for op". Also observed stale KV cache sizes.
morgan_serving: reproducer locally? tried running small batch on same model config on one machine, couldn't reproduce. This looks at least partially cross-node.
jamie_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) drain affected nodes from scheduler 2) failover traffic to fallback model variant (lower memory, no pipeline parallel) 3) collect nccl debug logs + coredump 4) escalate to hw team if driver resets continue. executing now.
jamie_oncall: `kubectl cordon node/gpu-ephemeral-17 && kubectl drain node/gpu-ephemeral-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`
rachel_infra: cordoned nodes 17,18,19 from gpu-pool-b. Kube drain in progress. Noting one container failed to terminate cleanly - forcing deletion.
priya_support: routing change pushed to rollback to model:open-quantized-xsmall for affected tenants. No config change required from customers.
morgan_serving: enabling NCCL debug env on a fresh node to capture logs: `export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO; export NCCL_DEBUG_SUBSYS=ALL` and restarting runner.
jamie_oncall: deploy-bot: trigger canary rollout to fallback variant and route 30% traffic now.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started. 30% traffic rerouted to model open-quantized-xsmall-canary. Link: https://deploys.internal/rollout/3789994321
priya_support: initial customer impact: 12 requests failed in last 5m across two tenants. alerts to customers sent. CS will post update in status page: "degraded inference performance for some requests".
ton y_ml: collected nccl logs from one drained node, attached snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T03:13:21Z] NCCL INFO Comm rank 2 size 8 : Allreduce start
[2026-03-15T03:13:22Z] NCCL WARN TIMEOUT: wait op on ring 1 exceeded 30s
[2026-03-15T03:13:22Z] CUDA Xid 79: GPU hang detected, initiating driver reset
```
morgan_serving: also grabbing dmesg and docker logs, saving to /var/log/incidents/3789994321/ for postmortem.
jamie_oncall: after draining, tail latency for generate has dropped to baseline for 70% of traffic. Canary looks healthy so far. keeping pager open for 30m.
priya_support: status page updated. customers notified. :white_check_mark:
morgan_serving: snapshotting KV cache sizes and pipeline state for the affected runs; will upload to S3 bucket s3://redwood-incident-evidence/3789994321
rachel_infra: driver team engaged. preliminary suspicion: sporadic firmware glitch on NIC causing packet drops leading to NCCL rendezvous timeouts. collecting NIC counters.
jamie_oncall: next steps: continue monitoring, keep nodes cordoned until driver stable, collect all logs for postmortem. If we see another Xid reset after uncordon, we'll open hardware replacement tickets.
tony_ml: adding model-level mitigation: reduce TP group size for next small rollout to avoid cross-node collectives until root cause resolved.
priya_support: will prepare customer follow-up update in 1h with remediation steps and ETA.
jamie_oncall: thanks team. marking incident as 'mitigated' for now but leaving thread open for evidence collection. If anything flares, ping with @here. :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: Incident 3789994321 transitioned to MITIGATED at 03:24 UTC by jamie_oncall. Postmortem required: yes. Severity: P1."
